job: Arfa Yapi apartment blocks, Bayrakli, Izmir - Block A1

stages.title: Footing and garden floor
stages.desc: Two courses of Nudura footing forms under every ICF wall, then the garden-floor walls (6 courses): 8in Standard external walls, 6in Standard party, stair and lift walls, the entrance and balcony openings, and the 100 mm block partitions.

stages.title: Ground floor
stages.desc: Ground-floor ICF (6 courses) with its balcony doors and windows, the stair / lift core and the block partitions.

stages.title: First floor
stages.desc: First-floor ICF and block partitions - the typical floor.

stages.title: Third floor, roof parapet and penthouse
stages.desc: Third-floor ICF and partitions, the 2-course ICF parapet round the roof terrace and the stair / lift penthouse.

stages.title: Complete block
stages.desc: The frame by others for coordination: 20 cm RC floor and roof slabs, balcony slabs with 10 cm RC parapets, the core stair, and the windows and doors fitted tight to the 25 mm ICF overfly.
